data.summary: In Week 1, Jackson completed 17 of 25 passes for 324 yards and a touchdown, plus a score on the ground, powering the Ravens to 506 total yards and a franchise first: a 300-yard passer, 150-yard receiver, and 100-yard rusher all in one game. With no interceptions and a passer rating over 120, Jackson's performance highlighted his long-term improvement, fueling excitement for Baltimore's 1-0 start in a tough AFC.
